steps.text: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.
In a second bowl, whisk the milk, egg, melted butter and vanilla.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir until just combined. A few lumps are fine.
Rest the batter for 5 minutes while the pan heats.
Heat a lightly buttered skillet over medium heat.
Pour a quarter cup of batter per pancake and cook for 2 minutes, until bubbles form.
Flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more, until golden. Serve warm.
